pipes.name: var-rate-pipe
pipes.description: Sifting pipe with runtime-injectable compression rate. Default: 0.5.

pipes.name: var-missing-pipe
pipes.description: References ${REQUIRED_VAR} with no default — must fail-fast with a clear error.

pipes.name: var-multi-pipe
pipes.description: Multiple ${VAR} substitutions in a single node args list.

pipes.name: var-env-fallback-pipe
pipes.description: References ${FALLBACK_RATE} — no pipe default, must fall back to os.environ.

pipes.name: var-empty-default-fail-pipe
pipes.description: Var declared with empty default → must fail-fast with a clear error BEFORE any node spawns. This tests the positive path of REPORT_038's fail-fast mechanism.

pipes.name: var-empty-default-pass-pipe
pipes.description: Same empty-default declaration but with --var TOKEN=abc provided. Must succeed.
